Select compounds reported in the specified document. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, filtering by doc chembl_id CHEMBL1126800. Join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical SMILES. Return molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name (pref_name), max_phase, molecule_type, and canonical_smiles. Sort by molecule_chembl_id ascending.
